The Defense Contractor at the Center of the Ground Stop

Until its upgrade work upended U.S. air travel, L3Harris was Washington’s go-to for fixing projects that other contractors mishandled

By

L3Harris Technologies LHX -0.11 % decrease; down pointing triangle, the major defense contractor responsible for much of the U.S. air traffic’s communications system, calls itself the “trusted disruptor.”

Its upgrade of the communications system caused unprecedented turmoil. A technician’s installation of a router triggered a cascade of failures that forced federal aviation officials to ground domestic air traffic for hours on Friday, upending thousands of flights and the travel plans of tens of thousands of Americans, while putting a bull’s-eye on the under-the-radar but vitally important contractor.
